referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The direct Smile! San Francisco website in San Francisco, California uses a city panorama behind a centered translucent text panel. Navigation is thin white utility header with visible appointment and phone actions. Its page moves through city-photo opening, human-scale practice video, asymmetric clinician and treatment collage, compact service matrix, choice rationale, review band, office image strip, solid blue booking close, with small named treatments gathered into a restrained matrix. wide city context and authentic practice scenes. Transferable mechanics are city-scene promise, service matrix, blue booking close. The brand identity, people, photographs, reviews, wording and business claims remain source-only.
